name: cost-quality-evaluation
description: JEV criteria for evaluating optimal cost optimization actions based on resource usage patterns, cost history, and historical outcomes

options.description: Reduce the number of running instances to lower compute costs
Migrate to spot/preemptible instances for significant cost savings
Adjust instance types to match actual resource utilization patterns
Implement auto-scaling policies to optimize costs based on demand
Move data to appropriate storage tiers based on access patterns

evaluation_factors: Resource usage trends, cost history, and growth rates
User feedback scores and satisfaction ratings for current configuration state
Historical success rates for each optimization action in similar cost scenarios
Time sensitivity and potential impact on users during optimization process
Risk of introducing new issues with more invasive cost approaches
